headline: GLOBE THEATRE DESTROYED BY FIRE; STAGE CANNON IGNITES THATCHED ROOF
dispatch: London, 29 June 1613. The celebrated Globe Theatre on Bankside was reduced to ashes this afternoon when a theatrical cannon, fired during a performance of a history play, cast a burning wad into the thatched roof above the stage. The blaze spread with terrible swiftness through the timber galleries. All persons within escaped with their lives, though the building is a total loss.
answer: Globe Theatre burns down during Henry VIII performance, 1613
